findings.scope: root/GUI index, agent-history wording and human paragraph
findings.fact: Actual launch argv only wins when launch.program is nonempty str and launch.arguments is all-str list. Otherwise record.command is compatibility/planned fallback; generated execution_bundle.path is logical plan, not observed process startup. Completed adapter newly binds passed/non-stale Generate/Run; does not promise every terminal action.
findings.requested_wording: 有有效launch收据时优先显示实际program/arguments及逻辑cwd；无有效launch时兼容显示record.command（计划/记录命令，不称实际启动事实），目录依次取launch.working_directory、execution_bundle.path、Unknown。本次完成回调范围为passed且非stale的Generate/Run（含无package external）；不要泛称所有已执行/已完成动作已回绑。

findings.fact: Producer gives pending per layer/action. Freshness checking maps an already-passed layer to pending; unobserved or other layers remain their own states. Unknown statuses fall back unobserved.
findings.requested_wording: 服务对某个动作或证据层报告pending时，该项显示“进行中”；freshness核验可使原passed层暂为pending，其他层仍保留自身事实，不能将四层一并改称进行中。
